title: Trapcage
summary: Trapcage is a restrictive spell. It traps an opponent in a sphere of orange energy. This confinement can then be transported via magic or used to cause pain for the prisoner.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In [[Hernán Cortés' vault]], [[Hoffman]] used Trapcage to trap [[Den Fears]] after he pushed [[Lok Lambert]] out of harm's way. The spell caused Den great pain, forcing the Huntik team to surrender to [[Wilder]] and his team. When [[Dante Vale]] set off [[Hernán Cortés]]' traps, the spell was disrupted by some arrow and Den was freed. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

full_text:
Trapcage is a restrictive spell. It traps an opponent in a sphere of orange energy. This confinement can then be transported via magic or used to cause pain for the prisoner.

== History ==
In Hernán Cortés' vault, Hoffman used Trapcage to trap Den Fears after he pushed Lok Lambert out of harm's way. The spell caused Den great pain, forcing the Huntik team to surrender to Wilder and his team. When Dante Vale set off Hernán Cortés' traps, the spell was disrupted by some arrow and Den was freed. [The Power of Umbra]

'''Trapcage''' is a restrictive spell. It traps an opponent in a sphere of orange energy. This confinement can then be transported via magic or used to cause pain for the prisoner.

== History ==
In [[Hernán Cortés' vault]], [[Hoffman]] used Trapcage to trap [[Den Fears]] after he pushed [[Lok Lambert]] out of harm's way. The spell caused Den great pain, forcing the Huntik team to surrender to [[Wilder]] and his team. When [[Dante Vale]] set off [[Hernán Cortés]]' traps, the spell was disrupted by some arrow and Den was freed. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}
